minutes.headline: Commission asked its Select Board liaison to draft a Hollis Road house lease plan; most hearings were continued to Dec 18.
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission, meeting by Zoom, approved a 586 Reservoir Road RDA with a negative determination and conditions, and continued several hearings to December 18 (400 Leominster-Shirley Road, Electric Ave/Pierce Ave, 390 Howard Street, 12 Horizon Island Road). It heard advice on restructuring the Hollis Road house license into a proper lease, voted on several certificates of compliance, and referred the 950 Chase Road barn encroachment back to the Select Board.

budget_items.what_was_said: Michael Ray said the current rent is well below market and the license agreement does not restrict rent to the property's upkeep. He proposed a 10-year capital assessment, maintenance fund and market analysis.
Ray gave explicitly fictitious numbers to show how to back out minimum rent, a work credit for tenant maintenance and a market-rate discount, using an 11-month model.
The chair said informal estimates for tearing down the encroaching barn were in the neighborhood of a small five-figure sum, and she was reluctant for the town to bear it.
Commission approved a capped expenditure from its accumulated fund for annual heating system servicing, invoice to be paid via the town.

Applicant's engineer to send editable Word version of the 12 Horizon order of conditions; form 3 metrics to be supplied before the Dec 18 amendment hearing.
Plan to hold a special session for the Hickory Hills Lake report on the 29th, subject to quorum.
No change to Hollis Road management until an approved plan is in place in January.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission voted to take up a plan, drafted with Town Counsel, to restructure the Hollis Road house license into a lease; a draft is due by end of January.
Hearings on 400 Leominster-Shirley Road, Electric Ave/Pierce Ave, 390 Howard Street and the 12 Horizon Island Road amendment were each continued to December 18.
The 586 Reservoir Road request was approved with a negative determination, on the condition that erosion control mark the limit of work.
The commission referred the 950 Chase Road barn encroachment back to the Select Board to decide on litigation.
The commission approved a capped expenditure from its own fund for Hollis Road heating service and held management unchanged until a plan is approved.

why_it_matters: The Hollis Road house is town-owned, and the minutes record a statement that its rent is below market under a license that does not tie rent to upkeep, so a new lease could change what that property returns to the town.
The Chase Road barn question now sits with the Select Board, which a resident may see on a future agenda as a decision on whether the town pays for removal or goes to court.
